thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: latency SLO breach detected for router-usw2 (p99 > 5s, streaming stalls increase). Alert ID: ALRT-214159. Triggered at 2026-03-14T10:10:30Z.

oncall-alex: acked — investigating. grabbing traces and recent deploys.

sre-lee: seeing p95 ~ 1.2s but p99 spikes to 6-9s on streaming paths. dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/latency/router-usw2 (worth watching). Could be a routing skew to a small set of shards.

eng-runtime-maya: pulling router logs now. I see lots of `503` retransmits and long backend connect times from lb-proxy-03. Also a sudden surge of requests hitting shard-17.

sre-lee: confirmed hot partition on shard-17. weight distribution for hashing shows skew — some LB policy rollouts yesterday had new affinity rules.

eng-platform-rajesh: I rolled the new egress affinity policy last night to canary 10% in usw2 around 02:00Z. Could be the canary misclassifying keys and sending too many streaming sessions to shard-17.

oncall-alex: can we validate? maya/rajesh, can you show current routing table? paste minimal snippet.

eng-runtime-maya: pasting relevant snippet:
```
# routing weights (simplified)
shard-15: 0.08
shard-16: 0.07
shard-17: 0.62  # unexpectedly high
shard-18: 0.10
shard-19: 0.13
```

eng-platform-rajesh: that 0.62 is the problem. Can reproduce locally by running the same key-hash mapping with config v2026-03-13. Looks like a bug in `hash_bucket()` when `affinity=true` + streaming flag.

prod-jordan: impact: external customers report streaming stalls and aborted sessions; internal telemetry shows ~4 customers with sustained errors > 50rps each. Need mitigation and customer comms.

support-emily: I'll surface to affected customers and draft a tentative note: "We are investigating increased latency and streaming stalls in US-WEST-2. No data loss. Engineers are mitigating now." Any ETA?

oncall-alex: immediate mitigation options: 1) revert canary affinity change 2) temporarily adjust routing policy to cap shard-17 weight 3) scale up capacity behind shard-17. Let's execute 2 + 3 now (lowest blast radius).

eng-runtime-maya: applying cap: `routerctl set-weight shard-17 0.12 --reason "hot partition emergency cap"`

incident-bot: Deploy bot: change request accepted, change id CHG-214159-1 queued.

eng-platform-rajesh: also pushing a fast rollback of the affinity canary to 0% (will take ~40s for configuration propagation).

oncall-alex: scaling pool for shard-17 + adding ephemeral nodes: `k scale deploy router-shard-17 --replicas=6` — doing now.

sre-lee: after weight cap and scale, p99 dropped from ~7.8s to ~2.1s within 30s. Streaming stall rate decreasing. Monitoring closely.

prod-jordan: good — start incident ticket (INC-214159) and run a brief RCA plan. Jordan -> I'll own customer comms with Emily.

support-emily: drafting note and will send initial advisory to affected contacts: ETA ~15m for follow-up.

eng-runtime-maya: collecting traces and tail logs for shard-17; saving core dumps for any streaming worker timeouts.

eng-platform-rajesh: root cause hypothesis: canary affinity policy miscomputes bucket weights when session streaming flag present; leads to huge logical weight on one shard (hot partition). Rollout validation missed because synthetic traffic didn't include streaming flag.

oncall-alex: action items:
- eng-platform: ship hotfix for `hash_bucket()` and revert canary config (in progress)
- eng-runtime: add guard in router to cap per-shard weight delta (short-term)
- sre: monitor p95/p99 across regions and enable auto-cap triggers if weight > 0.25 for > 30s
- support/prod: customer notifications + postmortem timeline

incident-bot: Note: paging will be canceled when p99 < 1.5s for 10m sustained.

sre-lee: current metrics: p95=0.9s, p99=1.9s, streaming stalls down 78%. Logging increased 503->200 success. Will keep pager open until stable for 15m.

prod-jordan: thanks all. once stable, we'll convert to Sev2 follow-up and add to postmortem board.

support-emily: sent initial advisory to affected customers. Reply from one customer: "appreciate update, will continue to monitor".

eng-platform-rajesh: hotfix PR opened: `#5678` with unit + simulation tests for streaming flag. Requesting quick review.

oncall-alex: good work. moving to monitoring loop. if anything regresses ping here and @oncall-alex will re-escalate. :thumbsup:
